title: Medullary
summary: MED'ULLARY, a. [L. medullaris, from medulla, marrow.] Pertaining to marrow; consisting of marrow; resembling marrow; as medullary substance.

inlines.v: MED'ULLARY, a. [L. medullaris, from medulla, marrow.] Pertaining to marrow; consisting of marrow; resembling marrow; as medullary substance.
